ext.description: See your agent's memory think: what it remembers, why, and what it chose to forget. VSA-based, local-first, no cloud — map, timeline, facts and token cost.
config.command: hipercampo executable. If it isn't on PATH, put the full path, or "python -m hipercampo.cli".
config.dbPath: Path to the .db file (HIPERCAMPO_DB). Empty = whatever hipercampo uses by default.
config.namespace: Context to show (HIPERCAMPO_NAMESPACE). Empty = "default". Ignored when "all contexts" is on.
config.allNamespaces: Show the whole file, not just one context.
config.linked: Fallback used only when no hipercampo MCP server is found on this machine (HIPERCAMPO_LINKED for the viewer's own CLI calls). Normally edit HIPERCAMPO_LINKED with the 🔗 button instead: it writes the real .mcp.json / ~/.claude.json server entries.
